characters.continuity: Devil May Cry series (Dante's standard Devil Trigger, DMC1 to DMC5)
characters.summary: Dante's standard Devil Trigger: a demonic state that raises his strength and speed, steadily regenerates his health, and changes with his equipped melee weapon, which can grant abilities including flight. In DMC5 it is the base form beneath Sin Devil Trigger, whose gauge is built from DT bars.

techniques: Enhanced melee attacks with his equipped Devil Arm
Swords Formation (DMC5 Devil Trigger skill, costs two DT bars)

mechanisms: Health regenerates at a steady pace while Devil Trigger is active

weaknesses: Not established by the opened sources
mobility: Flight in Devil Trigger depends on the equipped melee weapon
limitations: Limited by the Devil Trigger gauge; the Trigger Heart skill exists to extend its duration (DMC5)
characters.formDifferences: Compared with base Dante: greater strength and speed, steady health regeneration, and weapon-dependent abilities such as flight.

sources.supports: Devil Trigger gives greater strength and speed, steadily regenerates his health, and changes with the equipped melee weapon, including flight; weapons Rebellion and Ebony & Ivory
DMC5: Trigger Heart extends Devil Trigger duration; Swords Formation consumes two DT bars

conditional.dependsOn: Equipped melee weapon while in Devil Trigger

campaignTags.claim: His health regenerates at a steady pace while Devil Trigger is active

unknowns: Gemini's 'overpowered Vergil in their final clash via Devil Trigger' (DMC3) is not on the opened pages; the base games:Dante record carries the sourced Vergil results.

Reviewed by Claude (2026-11-13): replaced the unopened devilmaycry.fandom.com/wiki/Devil_Trigger cite with a Wikipedia mirror of Dante's article and a DMC5 guide. Restored DT strength/speed, health regeneration and weapon-dependent flight. Removed Stinger and Summoned Swords (not DT-specific on the pages), 'demonic aura', and the unsourced Vergil feat/result. Tags: broad `healing` removed, `self-regeneration` added; `natural-flight` removed because DT flight depends on the weapon.

characters.summary: Sin Devil Trigger is Dante's DMC5 form, unlocked when he absorbs the broken Rebellion and the Devil Sword Sparda into the Devil Sword Dante. It gives super armor, new moves such as Sin Stinger, and Air Raid hovering, but it does not restore health and lasts only briefly.

techniques: Sin Stinger: flies toward the enemy and cuts with the sword
Sin Inferno: explosion on hitting the ground

mechanisms: Super armor: cannot be staggered or knocked down
Activation cancels any current action with absolute priority

weaknesses: Not established by the opened sources
limitations: Health is not restored by Sin Devil Trigger
The SDT gauge takes 12 bars of the regular DT gauge to fill
The form does not last long
characters.formDifferences: Beyond standard Devil Trigger: super armor, Air Raid hovering and new attacks (Sin Stinger, Sin Inferno), with its own gauge; unlike standard DT it does not restore health.

sources.supports: SDT unlocked after acquiring Devil Sword Dante; 12 DT bars fill the SDT gauge; overrides current action; super armor; Air Raid hover; health not restored; used against Urizen
Plot: Dante unlocks his full demonic power and the Devil Sword Dante by absorbing Rebellion; Nero and V reach Dante as he defeats Urizen; Nero interrupts Dante and Vergil's fight
SDT abilities Sin Stinger and Sin Inferno; own gauge; the form doesn't last long

feats.claim: Unlocked his full demonic power and the Devil Sword Dante by absorbing Rebellion, then defeated Urizen

notableResults.note: Dante defeats Urizen; V merges with Urizen (restoring Vergil) before Dante can finish him
Nero intervenes, forces Dante out of the fight and defeats Vergil himself

conditional.dependsOn: Possessing the Devil Sword Dante and a filled SDT gauge

campaignTags.claim: Dante's SDT has Air Raid, which lets him hover (Vergil's SDT cannot)

unknowns: Nico's in-game report says there is 'no telling' how strong SDT Dante is, maybe more than Sparda; that is in-universe speculation, not a feat.
Whether Dante is in SDT for the whole interrupted Vergil fight in the main story is not stated; the Perfect Devil Trigger page describes SDT use in Vergil's boss fight.

Reviewed by Claude (2026-11-13): replaced the unopened Sin_Devil_Trigger cite with three opened pages. Restored Sin Stinger, the Urizen win (now sourced and qualified) and added the interrupted Vergil fight. Removed 'demonic energy beams', 'superhuman regeneration' (the page says SDT does not restore health) and teleport. Tags: `healing` removed (contradicted), `natural-flight` kept (Air Raid hover).

characters.continuity: Donkey Kong Country series and Donkey Kong 64 / Super Smash Bros.
characters.summary: Diddy Kong is Donkey Kong's agile sidekick. He fights with cartwheels and high jumps, shoots twin Peanut Popguns, and flies with his Barrel Jet (Rocketbarrel Boost). With Dixie he rescued Donkey Kong from Kaptain K. Rool in DKC2.

techniques: Peanut Popguns (twin wooden pistols that shoot peanuts)

mechanisms: Can hold a barrel in front of himself for protection (DKC2)

weaknesses: In Smash, a hit during Rocketbarrel flight knocks off his jetpack and he falls
mobility: Flies with the Barrel Jet (Rocketbarrel Boost)
limitations: DK64: Rocketbarrel is powered by Crystal Coconuts and is barred in some areas
Smash: overcharging the Popgun makes it explode in his hands; flying into a wall explodes the pack

sources.supports: Rocketbarrel Boost lets Diddy fly with his Barrel Jet (DK64, Smash, Tropical Freeze); Crystal Coconut power; jetpack lost when hit; wall collision explodes it; Popguns usable in flight
Peanut Popguns are Diddy's signature weapon since DK64; Smash charging and overcharge explosion
DKC2: Diddy and Dixie rescue DK and defeat Kaptain K. Rool on the Flying Krock and again in the Lost World; Diddy's cartwheel, super-jump and barrel shield
DKC: Donkey Kong and Diddy defeat K. Rool on the Gang-Plank Galleon; DKC2 Lost World win by Diddy and Dixie
DKCR ending: with Diddy on DK's back, the Barrel Jet and DK's wind-up punch send the moon down onto the Tikis' base

feats.claim: His Barrel Jet carried DK in the DKCR ending as the Kongs sent the moon down onto the Tikis' base

notableResults.citation: Donkey Kong Country 2: Diddy's Kong Quest
notableResults.note: With Dixie, on the Flying Krock (DK delivered the final punch) and again in the Lost World
With Donkey Kong on the Gang-Plank Galleon

campaignTags.claim: Flies with his Barrel Jet jetpack (Rocketbarrel Boost)
Fights with the Barrel Jet jetpack and twin Peanut Popguns

unknowns: Reviewed by Claude (2026-11-13): replaced the unopened donkeykong.fandom.com cite with five opened Super Mario Wiki pages. Restored Popguns, cartwheel and Rocketbarrel with sourced limits. Replaced the unsourced 'flew across jungle canyons' feat with the DKCR ending; the K. Rool result is now DKC2 (with Dixie) plus DKC1 (with DK). Removed 'super-speed', 'high agility' and the low-mass weakness. Tags `powered-flight` and `gadgets` kept.

characters.continuity: Donkey Kong Country series / Super Smash Bros.

techniques: Hand Slap and Headbutt (Smash move tables)

characters.continuity: Doom series (Doom 1993/Doom II marine through Doom 2016/Doom Eternal Doom Slayer)
characters.summary: Doomguy, later the Doom Slayer, fights Hell's armies with an arsenal that includes the chainsaw, Super Shotgun and BFG 9000. In Doom Eternal he wears the Praetor suit, was enhanced by the Divinity Machine, and kills the Icon of Sin by stabbing its brain with the Crucible.

techniques: Glory kills and blood punch (Doom Eternal)

mechanisms: Praetor suit: powered combat exoskeleton with life support, armor and fall-impact compensation
Glory kills make demons drop more health

weaknesses: Not established by the opened sources
mobility: Superhuman speed from the Divinity Machine (Doom Eternal lore)
limitations: Praetor suit protection depends on armor pickups and upgrades

sources.supports: Weapons include the chainsaw, BFG and Super Shotgun; Praetor Suit exomantle; seraphim enhanced him with superhuman strength, durability and speed
Doom Eternal Icon of Sin fight: armor stripped, BFG-9000 recommended, Crucible breaks armor and is stabbed into its brain, killing it
Seraphim/Samur Maykr reversed the Divinity Machine on the Slayer, giving unnatural strength and speed
Praetor suit is a powered combat exoskeleton with life support, armor, upgrades and impact compensation
Glory kills increase monster health drops (Doom 2016/Eternal) and charge the blood punch (Eternal)

feats.claim: Stripped the Icon of Sin's armor and killed it by stabbing its exposed brain with the Crucible

notableResults.note: Killed with the Crucible after destroying its armor and flesh

campaignTags.claim: Wears the Praetor suit, a powered combat exoskeleton

unknowns: The classic and modern incarnations share one roster id; the Praetor suit and Divinity Machine apply only to the modern Doom Slayer.

Reviewed by Claude (2026-11-13): replaced the unopened doom.fandom.com cite with a Wikipedia mirror and four Doom Wiki pages. Restored weapons, Praetor suit, glory-kill health and the Icon of Sin kill (Crucible). Dropped 'countless legions single-handedly' and 'virtually indestructible'. Divinity Machine is now sourced as strength and speed. Tags: `powered-armor` kept; `gadgets` removed (the BFG is a weapon, not a gadget).

Robot armies and Sonic copies such as Metal Sonic

limitations: Not established by the opened sources
